title: Vichoreya Mareya Akbar Aa Vi Ka
body:
Vichoreya Mareya Akbar Aa Vi Ja
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Eh Ronay Mukday Na Eh Athroo Sukday
Mukde Jaande Neh Saah
<<DIVIDER>>
Kithai Kayaam Tu Kita, Kitay Jhokaan Layaan
Koiye Khabar Na Awai
Jaan Sukdi Jaway, Es Fikaraan De Vich, Dil Darda Eh Mera
<<DIVIDER>>
Din Charke Jeevain Dhal Da, Raat Jivain
Pehndi, Eho Mamool Mera
Teray Hujray Main Teray, Aun Walay Rah Tak, Qaid Hogayaan Bhira
<<DIVIDER>>
Tur Vi Jaway Te Ehna Band Nahi Hona Hun Teri Shaadi Tayeen
Teray Shagna De Veeran Bhen Ne Chaa Saaray Akhiyaan Ch Laye Vasa
